record: Amendment A2 -- clarification C2 (Issue 2 remaining protocol decisions)
type: post-hoc pre-training clarification of approved amendment A2; completes C1

linked_to.relationship: A2 (approved, byte-identical) -> C1 (Issue 2 decisions, byte-identical) -> C2 (this file: resolves C1's OPEN-1..OPEN-5). Precedence: C2 governs the five points below; C1 and A2 govern everything else.

notation.rows: candidate rows (decision state x candidate); every state has exactly 298 rows (Issue 3)
notation.VALIDATION_rows: all candidate rows of VALIDATION-role trajectories (1,845 states x 298)

OPEN-1_zero_variance_features.rule: any admissible state feature with zero variance in TRAIN (TRAIN population SD = 0 over TRAIN decision states) is excluded from every state-space distance
OPEN-1_zero_variance_features.distance_features: the remaining 23 admissible state features (26 minus the three above)
OPEN-1_zero_variance_features.scaling: for each retained feature j: mu_j and sigma_j = mean and population SD (ddof = 0) over TRAIN decision states (one value per state, equal state weight); z_j(s) = (x_j(s) - mu_j) / sigma_j for every split; frozen once computed from TRAIN
OPEN-1_zero_variance_features.distance: d(s, s') = sqrt( sum over the 23 retained j of (z_j(s) - z_j(s'))^2 ); candidate descriptor excluded
OPEN-1_zero_variance_features.scope: applies to the 1-NN baseline and to the selector OOD distance. It does NOT change the model input whitelist (all 26 features stay model inputs) and does NOT change the exact-input lookup baseline, which matches on all 26 raw features (a state whose excluded feature is non-zero is simply 'unseen in TRAIN' and falls back to candidate x tick)

OPEN-2_baseline_selection_score.per_target_loss: for baseline b and target k in {future_T100, future_unmet}: L_k(b) = mean over VALIDATION rows r and over q in Q of rho_q(y_k(r), yhat_{b,k,q}(r)) (equal row weight, equal quantile weight)
OPEN-2_baseline_selection_score.validation_scale: S_k = population SD (ddof = 0) of y_k over all VALIDATION rows (equal row weight); a property of the frozen VALIDATION labels only, identical for every baseline
OPEN-2_baseline_selection_score.selection: the baseline with the smallest score among the four frozen baselines; exact ties (to 12 significant digits) broken by the frozen list order: mean by candidate, mean by candidate x tick, exact-input lookup, 1-NN
not_used: lexicographic T100 -> unmet ordering (remains the downstream recommendation/evaluation order)

OPEN-3_MAE_point_prediction.rule: validation MAE uses the conditional MEAN prediction m_{b,k}(r): MAE_k(b) = mean over VALIDATION rows r of |y_k(r) - m_{b,k}(r)| (equal row weight)
OPEN-3_MAE_point_prediction.baseline_selector_tolerances: delta_U = 0.5 x MAE_future_unmet(selected baseline); delta_H = 0.5 x MAE_future_hazard_unmet(selected baseline); delta_T90 = delta_T100 = 0.5 tick
OPEN-3_MAE_point_prediction.learned_model: the learned selector's delta_U/delta_H use the learned model's own conditional-mean VALIDATION MAE by the same formula
OPEN-3_MAE_point_prediction.quantiles: quantile outputs stay separate and never redefine the MAE point prediction
OPEN-3_MAE_point_prediction.record_before_primary_test: the selected baseline's MAE values and resulting tolerances are recorded before any PRIMARY TEST evaluation

OPEN-4_selector_OOD_distance.metric: exactly the OPEN-1 distance: 23 retained admissible features, TRAIN-only mu/sigma, Euclidean, no candidate descriptor
OPEN-4_selector_OOD_distance.reference_set: TRAIN decision states (one point per state; equal state weight, consistent with Issue 3)
OPEN-4_selector_OOD_distance.threshold: tau = 99th percentile (NumPy 'linear') of { min over TRAIN states s' != s of d(s, s') : s in TRAIN }, i.e. each TRAIN state's leave-one-out nearest-neighbour distance (another TRAIN state with an identical input gives 0)
OPEN-4_selector_OOD_distance.rule: abstain -> d(s) when min over TRAIN states s' of d(s, s') > tau
OPEN-4_selector_OOD_distance.source: the '99th percentile of training nearest-neighbour distances' is frozen in selector_design.json step 5; C2 fixes only the unit (TRAIN decision states, leave-one-out) and the metric. Computed from TRAIN only; identical for the learned and the baseline selector; never derived from PRIMARY TEST or from any predictor
OPEN-4_selector_OOD_distance.interval_width_rule: the other step-5 abstention rule ((q_hi - m) on T100 of the chosen candidate > the 95th percentile of that width on VALIDATION) uses each selector's own predictor, the width over all VALIDATION rows with equal row weight, and NumPy 'linear' percentiles

OPEN-5_quantile_interpolation.rule: every empirical quantile or percentile in this protocol uses NumPy linear interpolation: numpy.quantile(values, q, method='linear') (NumPy's default, the convention already used in A1)
applies_to: baseline quantile predictions (empirical TRAIN quantiles within each baseline's grouping)

issue_2_completeness_checklist.eligible_baseline_set: FROZEN (A2; C1): mean by candidate; mean by candidate x tick; exact-input lookup with candidate x tick fallback; 1-NN ties averaged
issue_2_completeness_checklist.selection_criterion: FROZEN (C1): lowest VALIDATION primary prediction loss
issue_2_completeness_checklist.baseline_quantiles: FROZEN (A2: empirical TRAIN quantiles of the baseline's grouping; C2 OPEN-5 method)
issue_2_completeness_checklist.comparative_criterion: FROZEN (A2): learned-selector capture rate minus baseline-selector capture rate on improvable PRIMARY TEST states, paired 95% trajectory-clustered bootstrap, 2,000 resamples, seed 5544102, lower bound > 0
issue_2_completeness_checklist.no_primary_test_in_selection: CONFIRMED: selection, tolerances, OOD threshold and quantiles use TRAIN and VALIDATION only
